question: Where was the final match of Ultimate Kho-Kho League Season 2 played?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Cuttack**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cuttack** is one of the most prominent cities in the state of **Odisha**, India.
 
• It is often referred to as the **‘Silver City’** due to its famous silver filigree works.
 
• The city is known for its **rich cultural heritage**, historical significance, and being a hub for sports activities.
 
• The **Barabati Stadium**, located in Cuttack, is a major venue for hosting domestic and international sports events, including cricket and other tournaments.
 
• The **Ultimate Kho-Kho League Season 2 final** was organized in Cuttack, underlining the city’s growing importance in promoting indigenous sports in India.
 
• Cuttack is also the **judicial capital** of Odisha and houses the **Orissa High Court**.
 
• Its central location and excellent connectivity make it a popular choice for hosting major events, including sports leagues.

__
 
• **Bhubaneshwar**__

 __
 
• **Bhubaneshwar**, the capital of Odisha, is known as the **‘Temple City of India’** due to its numerous ancient temples.
 
• The city is an important center for **education, IT, and tourism** in Odisha.
 
• Bhubaneshwar has hosted several national and international sports events, including the **Hockey World Cup**.
 
• Although it is a major sports venue, the **Ultimate Kho-Kho League Season 2 final was not held here.**
 
 
 
• **Sambalpur**__
 __
 
• **Sambalpur** is famous for its rich cultural heritage, particularly the **Sambalpuri sarees** and traditional music.
 
• The city is located on the banks of the **Mahanadi River** and is known for its **Hirakud Dam**, the longest earthen dam in the world.
 
• While Sambalpur is a historically and culturally significant city, it was not chosen as the venue for the final match of the Ultimate Kho-Kho League Season 2.
 
 
 
• **Rourkela**__
 
 
• **Rourkela** is known as the **‘Steel City of Odisha’** and is home to one of India’s largest steel plants, the **Rourkela Steel Plant**.
 
• The city also has a strong sports culture and recently hosted matches during the **Men’s Hockey World Cup 2023**.
 
• Despite its sports infrastructure, Rourkela did not host the Ultimate Kho-Kho League Season 2 final.
